draft.subject: Thanks for the time today
draft.opener: Thanks for the time today. Here is what I took away.

recap.text: After-hours calls ring out to a voicemail nobody checks until morning. You called that the real bleed.
Calls drop mid-transfer between locations at least a few times a day.
Fear of TCPA keeps you from texting patients at all today, even though your office manager wants it.

next_steps.text: I will run a 30-minute demo on Thursday covering after-hours routing and the compliant texting flow, no slides.

draft.body:
Hi Rahul,

Thanks for the time today. Here is what I took away.

What we covered:
- After-hours calls ring out to a voicemail nobody checks until morning. You called that the real bleed.
- Calls drop mid-transfer between locations at least a few times a day.
- Fear of TCPA keeps you from texting patients at all today, even though your office manager wants it.

Next steps:
- I will run a 30-minute demo on Thursday covering after-hours routing and the compliant texting flow, no slides.

Every line above came from something said on the call. If I got any of it wrong, tell me and I will fix it.

Best,
Maya
